title: APD Claims Adjuster, Rideshare
description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

We are seeking highly organized and customer-focused Commercial Auto Claims Adjusters to join our team in support of rideshare-focused auto physical damage claims. In this role, you'll manage claims involving commercial auto ride share exposures including driver and third-party incidents unique to the rideshare ecosystem. You’ll interact directly with rideshare drivers and affected third parties, ensuring a smooth, empathetic, and timely resolution of claims.

This role is ideal for someone experienced in the rideshare who can balance high-volume claims with top-tier customer service. You’ll also be instrumental in helping us refine our claims processes and tools for this unique line of business by collaborating with our product and engineering teams.

Who you are

• Highly motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org.

• Experience in commercial auto ride share claims a plus.

• Passionate claim professional who cares about the customer and their experience.

• Empathetic. You exercise empathy and patience towards everyone you interact with.

• Sense of urgency - at all times. That does not mean working at all hours.

• Creative. You can find the right exit ramp (pun intended) for the resolution of the claim that is in the insured’s best interest.

• Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it HAS to be conversational.

• Curious. You have to want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and action them to a prompt resolution.

• Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were done differently, you action on it.

• Communicative. (we'd love to know what this means to you)

• And did we mention, you have a sense of humor. Claims are hard enough as it is.

What you'll do

• Provide prompt, courteous and high-quality customer service to all policyholders and claimants by answering customer calls, filing claims, and resolving customer requests

• Gather necessary information from customers to initiate the claim and explain policy, coverage, and appropriate course of action

• Manage an inventory of claims, establish initial reserves for all potential exposures, and adjust as appropriate throughout the claim

• Coordinate the repair of damaged vehicles and assist with rental reimbursement

• Recognize recovery opportunities in regards to subrogation and salvage, as well as total loss

• Ensure compliance with specific state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures

• Communicate with involved parties and negotiate appropriate settlements with claimants, insureds, and attorneys within approved payment authority

• Provide input for continuous development of claims guidelines, best practices, and process improvements

• Oversee and direct outside investigative service providers and work closely with the client and client counsel and investigative services to resolve the claim

• Engage in learning opportunities to build knowledge of personal lines

title: Technical Lead
description:
Technical Lead

Location: Bristol (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Team: Engineering

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Software Engineering Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

The role

You’ll join the Kaluza Technology community: a large team of product-focused and data-led Product and Platform Engineers working at serious scale. Our ecosystem is primarily based on TypeScript and React, utilising GraphQL and Kafka, backed by AWS and Terraform. Our work and responsibilities are diverse and wide-ranging, so you will need to have a product-minded problem solving attitude first and foremost. As a Senior Engineer you’ll own a slice of the product end-to-end, from the first design conversation to running it in production, and you’ll build it with AI coding agents as your default. We’re looking for someone whose judgement is worth more than their typing speed.

Engineers at Kaluza build with AI, and we mean that practically. From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and MCP access to the systems you need. Our tooling and conventions are evolving quickly, and you’ll have a heavy hand in defining how we build moving forward.

What you’ll do

- Set the technical direction for your team: be accountable for the solution designs and architecture decisions, work with your team on technical strategy, and assist them through ambiguity over the longer term.

- Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.

- Build with AI coding agents as your default: break work down so agents can execute it, direct them, review what they produce as carefully as a colleague’s PR, and maintain the tests and guardrails that let agent-written code merge safely.

- Own the health of your services: SLOs and SLAs, operational health reviews, post-mortems, and the in-hours support rota, with your turn on the on-call rota alongside the team.

- Coach the engineers around you: technical guidance for a mix of junior and senior engineers, pairing, and code review that teaches as well as gates.

- Connect your team to the rest of Kaluza: work with other Tech Leads and Principal Engineers on the wider architecture, and represent your team where platform decisions and engineering standards are made.

Major Technical Tender Return Coordinator
Role Purpose
The Major Technical Tender Return Coordinator is responsible for the leadership, coordination, and management of all major technical tender submissions, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and professionally presented proposals to clients. The role serves as the central coordination point between the sales team, internal factories, technical departments, and engineering resources to develop compelling and technically robust tender returns.
This position owns the complete tender return package, from enquiry review through submission, while supporting the transition of successful projects into the post-order delivery phase. A key element of the role is presenting technical solutions, equipment selections, and tender submissions directly to consultants, contractors, end users, and clients.
---
Key Responsibilities
Major Tender Return Management

• Take overall responsibility for the coordination and delivery of major technical tender submissions.

• Manage the complete tender return process from enquiry receipt to final submission.

• Review client specifications, tender documentation, and project requirements.

• Develop submission strategies to ensure commercial and technical requirements are effectively addressed.

• Ensure all tender returns are submitted on time and to the highest professional standard.

• Maintain tender schedules, document control, and submission records.

Technical Data Coordination

• Coordinate all technical information required for tender submissions.

• Liaise with internal factories and technical departments to gather and validate product information.

• Ensure technical data sheets, performance selections, calculations, drawings, and supporting documentation are accurate and complete.

• Verify compliance with project specifications and identify any technical deviations.

• Coordinate project-specific technical responses and clarifications.

Factory Coordination

• Act as the primary point of contact between the UK business and internal manufacturing facilities.

• Coordinate factory input relating to equipment selections, technical data, drawings, compliance documentation, and programme requirements.

• Ensure factory responses align with project specifications and client expectations.

• Facilitate communication between internal stakeholders and factory engineering teams.

• Support future product development discussions by providing feedback from market and project requirements.

Equipment Selection & Technical Compliance

• Coordinate equipment selections for major projects.

• Review project requirements against product capabilities.

• Ensure all proposed solutions meet technical, operational, and performance criteria.

• Manage compliance documentation relating to project specifications and industry standards.

• Prepare technical compliance schedules and responses to consultant queries.

Revit, CAD & Model Coordination

• Coordinate Revit and CAD requirements associated with tender submissions.

• Obtain and manage project-specific drawings and BIM information from internal resources.

• Ensure drawing packages are suitable for client review and submission.

• Coordinate updates and revisions throughout the tender lifecycle.

Client Presentation & Technical Engagement

• Present technical solutions and tender submissions to clients, consultants, and contractors.

• Deliver professional technical presentations explaining equipment selections, system design philosophy, and project compliance.

• Support the sales team during bid clarification meetings and client presentations.

• Respond to technical queries and provide clarification throughout the tender process.

• Build confidence in Geoclima's technical capabilities through clear and professional engagement.

Post-Order Project Coordination

• Support the handover of successful projects from tender stage into project execution.
